Striker scores twice in cup win
 
 The striker scored two second-half goals as the home side won the cup tie. The manager praised the team's spirit after a difficult first half. Fans celebrated long after the final whistle. The club now faces a tough away trip in the next round, against last year's champions.

New phone chip promises longer battery
 
 A chip maker has unveiled a processor for mobile phones that it says doubles battery life. The company said handsets using the chip would arrive next year. Analysts said the technology could reshape the smartphone market. Rival firms are expected to respond with their own designs soon.
